newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BENCO SAYS DIAMOND VENTURE ENDS, BUYS SHRS.
newsitem.headline: BENCO SAYS DIAMOND VENTURE ENDS, BUYS SHRS.

text.p: The Luderitz Bay joint venture, an agreement between Angra Pequena Diamond Co Ltd and a grouping of BHP Minerals International Exploration Inc and Benguela Concessions Ltd (Benco) has been terminated.
Benco said in a published announcement that the Benco-BHP grouping had sold their interest to Diamond Fields International Ltd, the parent of Angra Penquena.

In return the grouping had received 13.70 million shares in Diamond Fields at Canadian $0.11 a share. Benco, which will hold the shares for the grouping, said this was equivalent to an interest of some 11.6 percent in Diamond Fields.

Diamond prospecting operations by the Benco-BHP group on one of the two marine grants in the Namibian joint venture had defined an indicated and inferred ore reserve of 1.15 million carats averaging 0.34 carates in size, Benco said.
It said it was Diamond Fields' intention to take its subsidiary, Angra Pequena's, properties to commercial production of marine diamonds.
